title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15
lineage: CD -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording that starts with audience tracks before switching to crisp soundboard captures a rippin' Set 2 and the scorching debut of Touch.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its high‑energy second set and the first live version of "Touch," which many reviewers call “scorching” and a highlight of the night. Recording quality is mixed – the opening two songs are audience recordings, but from "Dupree's" onward the tape switches to full soundboard, delivering very nice clarity for the bulk of the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong enthusiasm for the music (especially Touch and Set 2) combined with a mostly clean soundboard recording after the first two audience tracks yields a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First two tracks are audience‑sourced, sounding ambient; from "Dupree's" onward it switches to full soundboard (SBD) with very nice clarity and balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual opener with "Playing" then "Crazy Fingers" caused pacing questions, but the rest of the set – especially a rippin' Set 2 – flows strongly and builds to the debut of Touch.
